timing: Committed after source-identity and schema inspection but before computing any candidate trade path, PnL, ranking or economic metric.

clarifications.prior_volatility: population standard deviation of one-minute log returns over 1,440 completed minutes, minimum 720, shifted by one bar
clarifications.atr: mean true range over 60 completed minutes, minimum 30, shifted by one bar
clarifications.lag_aggregation: return is close_t versus close_t-lag; quote volume, trade count, taker-buy quote and signed quote are rolling sums over exactly lag completed bars including t
clarifications.activity_transform: trade_count_z is the prior z-score of log1p(lag trade count); average_trade_size_z is the prior z-score of log(lag quote volume / max(lag trade count, 1))
clarifications.standardization: population standard deviation over a 10,080-minute rolling history, minimum 4,320 observations, shifted by one completed bar; no clipping or winsorization
clarifications.impact_efficiency: sign(flow) * lag log return / (prior_volatility * sqrt(lag) * max(abs(flow), 0.05))
clarifications.flow_activity_z: prior z-score of abs(lag signed taker flow ratio)
clarifications.previous_block: the same lag feature shifted exactly lag bars; state-transition families require the current and previous lag flows to have the same nonzero sign
clarifications.event_tie_break: signal time, descending score, then BTCUSDT before ETHUSDT
clarifications.funding_cashflow: -side * quantity * contemporaneous valuation price * funding rate for events with entry_time < calc_time <= exit_time
clarifications.top_trade_removal: set the largest ceil(10% of trade account returns) to zero and compound the remaining path in original order
clarifications.half_year_split: 2022-07-02T12:00:00Z, the exact midpoint of the registered development interval
